notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it this turn.
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat step 2.
